# <auto-generated/>
from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass
from koine_runtime import AggregateRoot, DomainInvariantViolationError
from ordering.enums.order_status import OrderStatus
from ordering.value_objects.order_id import OrderId
from ordering.value_objects.order_line import OrderLine


@dataclass(eq=False)
class Order:
    id: OrderId
    lines: tuple[OrderLine, ...]
    status: OrderStatus = OrderStatus.DRAFT

    def place(self) -> None:
        if not (self.status == OrderStatus.DRAFT):
            raise DomainInvariantViolationError("Order", "only a draft order can be placed")
        self.status = OrderStatus.PLACED

    def ship(self) -> None:
        if not (self.status == OrderStatus.PLACED):
            raise DomainInvariantViolationError("Order", "only a placed order can be shipped")
        self.status = OrderStatus.SHIPPED

    def cancel(self) -> None:
        if not (self.status == OrderStatus.PLACED):
            raise DomainInvariantViolationError("Order", "only a placed order can be cancelled")
        self.status = OrderStatus.CANCELLED

    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
        return isinstance(other, Order) and self.id == other.id

    def __hash__(self) -> int:
        return hash(self.id)


_AGGREGATE_ROOT_CHECK: type[AggregateRoot] = Order
